Kill [[Lev the Condemned]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
Must have access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]], see [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] for details.

===Objectives===
* Kill [[Lev the Condemned]] in [[North Kryta Province (War in Kryta)|North Kryta Province]]
* *BONUS* Kill Lev the Condemned in [[Hard Mode]]
* See [[Princess Salma]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 3 [[War Supplies]]
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 1 War Supplies

==Walkthrough==
If doing this quest with [[Henchman|henchmen]] in [[normal mode]], start from [[Bergen Hot Springs]] (with [[level]] 12 henchmen) rather than [[Lion's Arch]] (where they are level 10). 

Once in North Kryta Province, [[pull]] Lev to the [[Ascalon Settlement]], so that the friendly [[NPC]]s can help to defeat her. Unless your [[party]] can [[spike]] the boss, take down Lev's associates first and save her for last.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Wanted by the Shining Blade
:''"Lev the Condemned is a vile, jealous woman who has targeted the maidens of Kryta simply out of envy. Rumor has it she was once beautiful herself, but age and a life of vice have left Lev a haggard, spiteful wretch. Now, she roams the lands of Kryta terrorizing any woman who is fairer or younger than she...which is just about all of them. Travel to North Kryta Province and ending Lev the Condemned's resentful rampage and you will earn Queen Salma's favor and bounty."''
;After completion of The Battle for Lion's Arch
:''"Relive this classic event from War in Kryta! Lev the Condemned was a vile, jealous woman who targeted the maidens of Kryta simply out of envy. Rumor has it she was once beautiful herself, but age and a life of vice have left Lev a haggard, spiteful wretch. While the White Mantle held power, she roamed the lands of Kryta terrorizing any woman who was fairer or younger than she... which was just about all of them. Re-create this historic battle by traveling to North Kryta Province and ending Lev the Condemned's resentful rampage to earn Queen Salma's favor and bounty."''
